name: LAUNXP Biomedical Co., Ltd
summary: LAUNXP Biomedical Co. Ltd. specializes in developing innovative pharmaceutical treatments for various types of cancer. Their product line includes therapies designed to combat tumor growth and inhibit cell proliferation, notably utilizing advanced platforms such as virus-like nanoparticles and other nanoparticle-based drug delivery systems. The company was established on September 24, 2015, and its primary corporate operations are based in Taichung, Taiwan.
